here is an example curl request


bash
   export CENTML_ENDPOINT="https://someendpoint.com"
   export CENTML_BEARER_TOKEN="<BEARER_TOKEN>"
   export MODEL="Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct"


Create the request:
bash
   export IMAGE_B64=''
cat > /tmp/attributes-centml-request.json <<JSON
   {
     "model": ${MODEL},
     "messages": [
       {
         "role": "system",
         "content": "You are a product attribute extraction model. Return only a JSON object
 containing the requested attributes."
       },
       {
         "role": "user",
         "content": [
           {
             "type": "text",
             "text": "Extract attributes for: Womens Chelsea Shoe\nCategory: Apparel &
 Accessories > Shoes > Boots\nAttributes to extract: Color, Pattern, Material, Style"
           },
           {
             "type": "image_url",
             "image_url": {
               "url": "data:image/png;base64,${IMAGE_B64}"
             }
           }
         ]
       }
     ],
     "max_tokens": 2000,
     "temperature": 0.1,
     "logit_bias": {
       "151652": -100,
       "151653": -100,
       "151654": -100,
       "151655": -100
     }
   }
   JSON
 


Send the request:
bash
   curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body \
     --max-time 120 \
     --request POST \
     --url "${CENTML_ENDPOINT}/openai/v1/chat/completions" \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer ${CENTML_BEARER_TOKEN}" \
     --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --data @/tmp/attributes-centml-request.json
